shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surpassed $66K, fueled by $727M in ETF inflows over five days and positive regulatory developments.
Progress on the US CLARITY Act, with an agreement nearing, is boosting confidence for regulatory clarity in crypto.
Softer U.S. inflation data eased Federal Reserve rate hike fears, generally supporting risk assets.
Ongoing US-Iran conflict continues to fuel energy and broader geopolitical risks.
US is redirecting $200B federal research funding toward AI, which could impact crypto projects competing for investor funds.
